parts.text: Kachakonyan neighbours weren't particularly friendly historically, to say the least. Endless wars with Westenland and Graonia were hampering our economy and meant that we never really spread our wings. Thankfully, we bet on a good horse during the last War of Hegemony and we still possess close relations with the current hegemon empire, Matheuchelles. Our main rivals have their problems: Graonia doesn't seem to be a serious threat anymore, as their socio-economic backwardness is the basis of jokes in the whole Western Archipelago and Westenland is engaged in the long fight to maintain their overseas territories. We can sleep easy... at least for now.

As the loser in the last War of Hegemony, Graonia was forced into some really unfavorable treaties. Their economy is based on the export of raw materials, and any such agreement must be approved by Matheuchellyes. We are the beneficiary of contracts for the import of raw materials from Graonia, but some people believe that we should diversify supplies. 
 Graonia is a theocracy thus is ruled by Archpatriarch, seated in their capital of Grauinbid. However, their system shakes to its foundations as there is no stable majority in their parliament, called Ecclesia.

Although people would rather talk about differences between our countries, we have much in common with Westenland. Genetic and linguistic research proves that we have common ancestors, who arrived here thousands of years ago. Since then, both nations colonised most of the Rotorian Archipelago, with our part creating so called Kachakophone sphere, but more about it later. 
 In the last War of Hegemony between Leukia and Matcheuchellyes, Westenland chose to not support either of the sides, a decision they were able to push through thanks to its location in the most nocturnal part of the archipelago. The last few decades have seen Westenland fighting to maintain its colonies, often by force, as in the Hazelbor War of Independence. However, they are still a force to recon with as their navy is often considered the strongest in the region.

Matcheuchellyes, officially known as The Most Glorious Commonwealth of Matcheuchellyes has an unrivaled status of a global superpower. Their reach extends far beyond mere diplomatic ties, being the most populous country, having the largest GDP, the largest army and, of course, the largest navy. But it wasn't always like this. In the previous century, a multipolar order existed for a time, until three global Wars of Hegemony left only the Commonwealth on the battlefield, as they waited until the very end to get involved. People needed stability, and that's what Pax Mathea gave them. 
 But for many, it didn't come without a cost. Zelia had to come to terms with a significant reduction in territory, Graonia was stuck in unfavorable trade treaties, the Leukians, despite being the largest nation in the world, had to say goodbye to their united and independent state, and only geographical names remained of the Ertrogen Kingdom. However, in an era of unprecedented global prosperity, there are not many who would dare to challenge the established order.

As the aftermath of Kachakonyan the civil war, the old institutions were abolished and a parliamentarian democratic system was established. Almost a hundred years on, political scene remains stable as a few large parties dominated elections. After years in power, the old leader of the Republican Party of Kachakonya has retired a month ago. Before he left this world, he had managed to anoint you as his successor. Not everyone in the party is happy with his decision and we may expect some internal turmoils in the coming months.

options.description: Tell me more about the political scene.
I have every right to rule!

parts.text:
Our party is currently at the crossroads. Our traditional ideological stance was pretty reserved one, but progressive wing grew stronger and stronger over time and they demand we implemented some changes now. If we support their projects, we can count on their support. On the other hand, the Old Guard doesn't like your nomination. Yes, we got their votes in the parliament, but they are ready to undermine your efforts any time soon if they see any signs of weakness. 
 As to the opposition, we don't have to worry about them just yet as they were severely beaten in the elections. Our largest opponent is the Socialist Workers' Party of Kachakonya, an established party presenting social-conservative stance that has strong connections with labour unions. But the greatest surprise of the elections was Federalist Party. Once a marginal group, they somehow managed to attract many of the younger voters which allowed them to obtain the third largest club in parliament. Their main concern is what they call Pan-Kachakism. Ephesia, Chara, Marelland, even Capturia - they believe we are all the one nation, and the main force that prevents unification is Matheuchellyes. And all of this seasoned with right-wing populism... Needles to say, the old political forces do not want to cooperate with these madmen.

options.description: I have every right to rule!
